issue.title: test_get_content_height_reserve_uses_last_title_not_trailing_roster_row fails under just check's parallel test-scoped lane, passes in isolation
issue.description: Discovered while landing an unrelated split of src/sase/bead/conflict_resolver.py into multiple files (no TUI code touched, tree at master 15c6b7a00). just check's parallel test-scoped lane failed this node alongside three other nodes in the same file already tracked as sase-x6 (deterministic active_section_identity==None failures); unlike those three, an isolated pytest rerun of this specific node on the same unchanged tree passed cleanly, matching the fails-parallel/passes-isolated shape of the retired sase-ct umbrella rather than sase-x6's deterministic shape. RELATED: sase-ct (retired umbrella for ACE TUI fails-parallel/passes-isolated nodes) and sase-j7 (in-progress epic fixing that flake class at its root).
